title: open-practices-repro-v1 player output
description: Per-target reproducibility judgements over the mocked repository.

target.description: A file name (one of input.files[].name) or the repo_url (for a broken_link defect).

flagged.description: True if this target carries a reproducibility / open-practices defect.

issue_kind.description: If flagged=true, the kind of defect: 'absolute_path' | 'uncommented_code' | 'missing_file_load' | 'broken_link' | 'dead_data_link' | 'available_upon_request' | 'materials_claim_no_link'; null otherwise.

confidence.description: Player's confidence in the judgement for this target.

evidence.description: Optional. Short snippet justifying the flag (e.g. the offending path).
